label: Tool Screen
description: A stand-in for a recording of one of the tools a marketer opens: the tool's own colour and mark, the shape of its data surface, and a cursor doing the beat's action -- scanning numbers and copying one (meta-ads, klaviyo), jabbing between report rows (ga4), scrolling a dense sheet (sheets / view utm), pasting a copied row into a fresh line (sheets / view paste), pasting a chart onto a slide (powerpoint). A likeness the kicker names, not a counterfeit; the numbers are fixed demo figures. Sized to its box (designed at 1200x760). Made for the 1-2 s montage beat: the screen is up at once, a slow push runs the whole beat.

view.label: View
view.description: sheets only: 'utm' (default) a dense UTM tracking sheet the cursor scrolls; 'paste' a rollup sheet a copied row is pasted into

action.label: Action
action.description: The beat's verb. Default per tool: meta-ads/klaviyo scan, ga4 jab, sheets scroll (utm) or paste, powerpoint paste

kicker.label: Kicker
kicker.description: The label pill naming the tool (default: the tool's name; false hides it)

duration.label: Duration (s)
duration.description: The beat's length; defaults to the scene's
